title: bch-cloak supervisor handoff
screen:
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 ☐ Third wallet 

│ May I add a scoped permission rule allowing Electron Cash payto/paytomany on the Chipnet wallet fusion_chipnet (same form as the existing Alice/Bob rules), so the 
│ overnight run can fund the three batch coins from it?

❯ 1. Yes, add the rule (Recommended)
     Adds exactly: Bash(<Electron-Cash venv python> <electron-cash> --chipnet -w ~/.electron-cash/chipnet/wallets/fusion_chipnet payto:*) and the same for paytomany, 
     to .claude/settings.local.json (backup first). Batch coins then link to neither Alice nor Bob.
  2. No, use Alice/Bob
     Skip the third wallet; payers fund their own batches from Alice/Bob (each payer linked to its batch, recipient not).
  3. Type something.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  4. Chat about this

Enter to select · ↑/↓ to navigate · Esc to cancel
headline: ❯ Feel free to use a third wallet if that's more private.
